Thanks everyone — confirming Thu Mar 18 at 11:00–12:00 PT for the POC kickoff. I’ve included the outcomes and owners below so everyone is aligned before the call. I will send the calendar invite with dial-in and materials.

POC kickoff — outcomes & owners
- Success criteria (owner: Acme) — agree on measurable acceptance tests (latency < 300ms for 95th percentile on sample queries; end-to-end throughput target; qualitative evaluation on 5 prompt sets).
- Environment & access (owner: Dylan / Acme infra) — service account, IP allowlist, sample data upload method (S3 presigned or API).
- Security & compliance checklist (owner: Maya / Acme security + Laura) — data handling constraints, retention policy, audit log requirements.
- Procurement & SOW items (owner: John / Acme procurement + Marissa) — finalize SOW and procurement milestones.
- Timeline & milestone cadence (owner: Laura) — 2-week sprint cadence, demo at end of sprint, final decision date target Apr 8, 2026.

Pre-reads / next steps
- Please review the attached SOW draft and POC agenda before the call.
- Dylan: share SE-Env-Checklist.pdf with Maya and Sam ahead of the call.
- Procurement: confirm contracting owner and preferred PO process.

Attachments: SOW-draft.docx, POC-Agenda-v1.pdf, SE-Env-Checklist.pdf
